shared_elements: low-relief figures carved on a flat slab
winged creature(s) with rows of feathers rendered as parallel incised lines
limbs or bodies filling most of the field
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces carry profile figures in shallow relief with wings whose feathers are indicated by rows of parallel incised lines. Otherwise the content diverges completely: A shows a single large, anatomically detailed bearded humanoid with enormous outspread wings dominating the whole slab, while B shows several small, highly schematic animals (long-billed birds, a snake-like creature, a quadruped) stacked in registers beneath a band of repeated abstract signs.
